title: Chapter 328 No One Left Alive
content:
Chapter 328 No One Left Alive

In the fairy world.

At this moment, the strong men couldn't hide their doubts and looked at the void with a serious expression.

Those creatures of the Wutuo tribe really retreated.

What the hell is going on?

"Have the leader not returned yet?"

Jin Shiyuan asked to someone next to him.

"No."

Everyone was silent.

They have a sense that something big is going to happen.

At this time, Chu Lingsheng rushed to the scene.

"Xiao Luo."

Scanning everyone at the scene, Chu Lingsheng looked directly at Xiao Luo and others.

At this time, Xiao Luo and Qin Feng were still together.

Over the years, Yuanyuan has reached the late stage of the Immortal Emperor Realm, although her strength is not as top in the Immortal Realm.

But what Yuanyuan is really powerful is naturally not her strength, but her alchemy ability.

Now, Yuanyuan deserves to be the number one alchemist in the fairy world.

Even Jordan Yang, a powerful alchemy master, was ashamed of himself.

Afterwards, Yuanyuan created the Immortal World Alchemist Guild, attracting alchemists from all over the Immortal World to come.

Because in the Alchemist Guild, you not only have the opportunity to be taught by the first alchemist in the fairy world, but you can also learn the Heavenly Refining Alchemist method that has fascinated countless alchemists.

That’s right, Yuanyuan dedicated the Heavenly Refining Alchemy method of Shi Liantian without reservation.

However, due to the difficulty of practicing the Tianli Alchemy, even if it is displayed in Yuanyuan, there are very few people who learn it.

It is worth mentioning that Jordanyang later joined the Alchemist Guild and became the vice president of the union, second only to Yuanyuan.

The purpose of Yuanyuan founding the Alchemist Guild was naturally to help Lu Xue.

Although she didn't help much, this was the only thing she could do for Lu Xue.

After all, few strong people are willing to risk offend alchemists in almost the entire fairy world.

"Huh? Chu Lingsheng?"

"Xiao Luo, I know where the leader has gone?"

Looking at Xiao Luo, Chu Lingsheng said mysteriously.

Hearing this, Xiao Luo, Qin Feng and Yuanyuan beside him all looked over.

"Speak quickly!"

When Xiao Luo heard the news from Lu Xue, he quickly said anxiously.

Only then did Chu Lingsheng speak, "A giant city."

A giant city!

Hearing this, Xiao Luo and the other two looked at each other and were shocked.

At this moment, they had already guessed something.

Could it be said?

"Tell me in detail!"

Immediately, Chu Lingsheng told them that he had discovered a giant city, where the Wutuo tribe was also there, and then Lu Xue took Ao Qing away.

After hearing what Chu Lingsheng said, Xiao Luo was silent for a moment and suddenly burst into laughter.

"It's over, it's over."

Everyone around looked at Xiao Luo suddenly going crazy, all frowning slightly.

"Xiao Luo, why are you crazy?"

"Yes, what's over."

At this time, Qin Feng, who was beside Xiao Luo, also relaxed his whole body, hugged the sword and looked up at the void, with a little emotion.

"Is the Wutuo clan? Haha, it's just a le."

Yuanyuan's always cold face is rare, and there is a little more smile.

"You will see the master soon."

Seeing a few people like this, everyone was even more confused.

What's going on? You guys say that, it's so anxious.

Looking at everyone's anxious appearance, Xiao Luo shook his head and smiled, "Ha, you don't understand."

Only those who have seen Lu Xue’s real background know what happened.

Everyone:...

Just pretended that everyone couldn't help but beat Xiao Luo.

But suddenly a huge vibration sound came from the void.

Everyone looked up suddenly and saw a million troops with a terrifying aura coming towards this place with neat steps.

In front of the army, it was Lu Xue and Ao Qing.

As for the dozens of people behind Lu Xue, the aura was even more unfathomable.

Seeing this scene, everyone present, except for Xiao Luo and the other two, widened their eyes and looked at the void with their mouths wide open.

"Then, is that the leader?"

Some people can't believe it.

Everyone was silent.

At this time, Lu Xue and Huangcheng and others landed in the fairy world.

The million-dollar army was on standby.

"Master of the Alliance."

When everyone saw Lu Xue, they hurriedly spoke respectfully.

Lu Xue nodded slightly and then said directly: "Everyone, are you willing to follow me to kill the Wutuo clan?"

Kill the Wutuo clan!

Everyone was slightly stunned, unable to believe their ears.

"Now?"

Lu Xue nodded again, "If you don't fight at this time, then when will you wait?"

Hearing this, everyone's breathing was a little rapid.

At this moment, they chose to believe Lu Xue unconditionally.

Because if it weren't for Lu Xue, they would have been destroyed by the Wutuo clan long ago.

"Kill the Ruwutuo clan!"

"Kill the Ruwutuo clan!"

For a moment, the entire fairy world began to shake, and its reputation was overwhelming!

And the other side of the abyss.

On a dark continent.

"Wutuxin is dead?!"

A sound of surprise sounded.

The next moment, several powerful figures soared into the sky.

When you reach the Immortal Emperor Realm, you will be able to reflect the projection of your debut, so as to borrow the power of your Tao.

When you reach the Immortal Emperor Realm, you can integrate yourself into the Tao and deeply understand the power of the Tao, and your strength is even more terrifying.

This is to enter the realm of Tao.

And when you have thoroughly understood the Tao, you can control the Tao, and every move and gesture is full of the power of Tao.

This is the realm of mastering the Tao.

After that, the strength is approaching the extreme and reaching the point where it can break the Tao, then it is the realm of breaking the Tao.

At this moment, the aura revealed by these powerful figures was a powerful person in the Taoist realm!

"If you dare to kill the people of my Wutuo tribe, then the immortal world is looking for death!"

"Everyone, follow me to enter the fairy world!"

With a command, countless powerful Wutuo clans responded immediately.

And at this moment, a cold voice suddenly came from afar.

"No need, we're here."

laugh!

A sword light flashed by.

The next moment, a huge hideous crack suddenly appeared above the Ziwutuo tribe without any warning.

Immediately afterwards, Lu Xue led all the strong men in the fairy world and the strong men in the deserted city to appear above the Wutuo tribe.

The enemy will go, and I can go.

At this moment, the extremely terrifying pressure poured down from the Wutuo tribe.

The entire Wutuo clan instantly seemed to have fallen into the doomsday.

"You, you guys!"

"How is this possible?!"

Those powerful people in the palm of the Taoist realm looked at the many terrifying powerful people in front of them, and all showed fear.

Especially the group of strong men behind Lu Xue.

Almost no less than them.

Where do so many strong people come from?

"The Wutuo tribe, from today, disappear into this world."

"No one of the Wutu tribes will be left."

Lu Xue issued a killing order with an expressionless face.

Then, a massacre began.

Of course, the main reason for killing the Wutuo clan is to kill the powerful people in the Huangcheng City. Everyone in the fairy world can only pick up the bargains.

At this moment, while fighting, they became more and more shocked.

Where did these powerful leaders come from?

It's so scary.

Especially those who came to their fairy world, they wouldn't have been worried for so long.

"Ah! Damn it, hurry up, inform the patriarch!"

Seeing his tribe members being brutally tortured, several powerful Wutuo tribes roared quickly.

The next moment, a powerful aura suddenly soared into the sky from the depths of the Wutuo tribe.

"You are so arrogant!"
